rounds.text: Fabtech Technologies Ltd is heavily discounted relative to its fundamental growth and sector benchmarks, trading at a P/E of 13.67x against a sector benchmark of 35.47x and an EV/EBITDA of 7.64x versus 20.84x [E6, E11]. This undervaluation offers a wide margin of safety, as a discounted cash flow model puts intrinsic value at Rs 311 per share against a market price of Rs 147, leaving a 52.7% margin of safety [E38, E39]. The business demonstrates robust top-line and bottom-line expansion, highlighted by compounded sales growth of 19% over the trailing twelve months and a staggering 111% compounded profit growth over the same period [E16, E19]. Operational health is further reinforced by conservative financing, with debt-to-equity standing at a low 0.12x and borrowings reduced from Rs 62 Cr to Rs 46 Cr year-over-year [E31, E32]. Institutional confidence is building alongside these fundamentals, evidenced by positive money flow and an increase in domestic institutional holdings from 1.99% to 2.45% [E36, E37]. Conceded: [E27], [E28], [E29], [E53].

Fabtech Technologies Ltd is trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, with a discounted cash flow model showing an intrinsic value of Rs 311 per share against a market price of Rs 147, offering a 52.7% margin of safety [E38, E39]. The stock is exceptionally cheap relative to its earnings power and sector benchmarks, carrying a P/E of 13.67x and EV/EBITDA of 7.64x compared to sector benchmarks of 35.47x and 20.84x respectively [E6, E11]. Growth metrics are robust, highlighted by a trailing twelve-month compounded sales growth of 19% and a phenomenal 111% compounded profit growth over the same period [E16, E19]. Furthermore, the company is conservatively financed with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.12x, having successfully reduced its borrowings from Rs 62 Cr to Rs 46 Cr over the year [E31, E32]. Institutional interest is backing this turnaround, evidenced by positive money flow and an increase in domestic institutional holdings from 1.99% to 2.45% [E36, E37, E63]. Conceded: operating cash flow is negative at Rs -1 Cr with a weak cash conversion of -0.04x for Mar 2026, and the stock is lagging the market below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E27, E28, E43].
